name: Mauritania
description: Mauritania from the Almoravids and the libraries of Chinguetti to French rule, independence in 1960, slavery and the desert.

checkpoints.name: Almoravids and caravans
checkpoints.note: The Almoravids rose here in the 1000s. Caravan towns such as Chinguetti and Ouadane held libraries of Islamic learning.

checkpoints.name: French Mauritania
checkpoints.note: France made Mauritania a colony, ruled from Saint-Louis in Senegal.

checkpoints.name: Independent Mauritania
checkpoints.note: Mauritania became independent in 1960 and built Nouakchott. Slavery was abolished only in 1981.
